# Archived workflows

GitHub Actions only runs workflow files directly inside `.github/workflows/`. The files here never run. They are kept so they can be revived later.

To revive one, move it back to `.github/workflows/`, then fix what its row below says it needs.

## Replaced by `ci.yml`

| File                        | What it did                                                                                         | Notes for reviving                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pr-checks.yaml`            | Core, GUI, binary, VS Code, packages and e2e checks on every PR and again on every push to `main`.  | Superseded. Its jobs now run in `ci.yml`, only when the change affects them.                                                                                                                            |
| `cli-pr-checks.yml`         | CLI lint and tests on 3 OSes × Node 18/20/22/24 (12 jobs).                                          | Superseded. Its matrix never changed the Node version: `setup-packages` reset Node to `.nvmrc` after the matrix `setup-node`. `ci.yml` uses `.github/actions/cli-test`, which selects the version last. |
| `pr-build-upload-vsix.yaml` | Built `.vsix` files for Linux, Windows and macOS on every PR push.                                  | Superseded. `ci.yml` uploads the Linux `.vsix`. For all 8 targets, run `publish-vscode.yaml` with `channel: dry-run`.                                                                                   |
| `main-build.yaml`           | On push to `main`, copied the Linux build artifact from the PR's run, for upstream's `oneper` tool. | Nothing in NextCLI consumes it.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `auto-fix-failed-tests.yml` | After a failed PR check run, started a remote agent session to fix the tests.                       | Disabled upstream with `if: false`. Needs `NEXTCLI_API_KEY` and a working `cn remote`. Update `workflow_run.workflows` to `["CI"]`.                                                                     |

## Upstream Continue tooling

| File                                                                                                         | What it did                                                                 | Notes for reviving                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `continue-agents.yml`                                                                                        | Reusable workflow that ran each `.continue/agents/*.md` agent on a PR.      | Nothing calls it. Grants `contents: write`, installs an unpinned CLI, has no `--readonly`. The AI checks now live in `ai-checks.yml`. |
| `run-continue-agent.yml`                                                                                     | Reusable workflow that started a hosted agent via `api.nextcli.dev/agents`. | Needs `NEXTCLI_API_KEY` and that API.                                                                                                 |
| `tidy-up-codebase.yml`                                                                                       | Weekly hosted agent that tidied markdown and opened a PR.                   | Guarded by `github.repository == 'continuedev/continue'`. Uses `run-continue-agent.yml`.                                              |
| `snyk-agent.yaml`                                                                                            | Daily Snyk scan by an agent.                                                | Guarded by the upstream repository name. Needs `SNYK_TOKEN` and agent `continuedev/snyk-code-scan-agent`.                             |
| `metrics.yaml`                                                                                               | Weekly issue and PR metrics posted to Slack.                                | Guarded by the upstream repository name. Needs `ISSUE_PR_METRICS_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`. Remove the `nate/metrics-action` push trigger.   |
| `similar-issues.yml`                                                                                         | Suggested similar issues and discussions using Chroma.                      | Disabled with `if: false`. Needs `CHROMA_CLOUD_API_KEY`, `CHROMA_TENANT`, `CHROMA_DATABASE`.                                          |
| `upload-runloop-blueprint.yml`, `runloop-blueprint-template.json`, `runloop-blueprint-staging-template.json` | Uploaded Runloop dev-box blueprints.                                        | Guarded by the upstream repository name. Needs `RUNLOOP_API_KEY`. The templates download from `continuedev/suggestions-cli`.          |
| `label-merged-prs.yml`                                                                                       | Added `tier 1-3` labels to merged PRs by Continue staff.                    | Replace the hardcoded list of Continue employees.                                                                                     |
| `auto-assign-issue.yaml`                                                                                     | Assigned new issues to one of five Continue employees.                      | Replace the assignees with NextCLI maintainers.                                                                                       |
| `docs-gh-pages.yml`                                                                                          | Built `docs-site/` and deployed it to GitHub Pages.                         | GitHub Pages is not enabled. The docs are published from the `nextcli-docs` repository.                                               |
